name: Civitai Sensei
description:
Civitai Sensei is a chat companion that lives inside Civitai and answers with the catalog in hand.

When your question turns on a specific model, Sensei looks it up — the model itself decides what to search for and can refine the search if the first attempt misses, rather than guessing from a keyword-stripped version of your sentence. Answers are grounded in what is actually on the site rather than what a language model half-remembers, and the Research panel shows you the query it used. You can search from the panel yourself too. Looking things up costs nothing. A reply spends Buzz at the model's live rate — a few Buzz per message, less for cheaper models and shorter answers. A question that needs a lookup may spend that more than once, because each lookup round is its own request; Sensei stops after a small number of rounds and tells you when it does.

Conversations stay put. Sensei keeps multiple sessions side by side, so a thread about lighting does not get tangled up with a thread about training settings. Sessions and their messages are saved to your own per-user app storage, where no other user can read them.

Three models are available: DeepSeek V3, GPT-4o mini, and Dolphin Mistral 24B, an uncensored option. Civitai's content policy still applies to every reply — when one is withheld, Sensei tells you so plainly instead of failing silently.

This is an early release. Sensei looks up models; it does not yet read images, articles or your own generations.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Generates chat completions via the orchestrator; each response spends the viewer's Buzz within the per-message budget. A question that needs a catalog lookup makes MORE THAN ONE such request: each lookup round is its own separately-quoted, separately-charged submit, bounded at 3 tool-result messages per payload, so a single question can cost up to 4 budgeted requests.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Not read by the app since 0.1.5 — the Civitai header shows the balance instead. The scope is retained only so that viewers who already granted it are not asked to consent again.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads session history and settings from per-user KV storage.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Writes session history and settings to per-user KV storage.
